title: Primary One Science — Term 3 scheme of work
summary: Ten teaching weeks, five 40-minute periods each week. The school literacy scheme supplies the sequence: transport; things we make and communication; environment; peace and security. Forty small teaching lessons leave the weekly review and final assessment periods to Ledgerly. Environment receives the greatest share because its school subtopics include animals, birds, plants and insects.

units.title: Transport
units.competences: The learner identifies means of transport, recognises road signs, and describes safe ways of using roads.

sources.quote: These are symbols put on roads to guide road users
How to control accidents on the road

lessons.title: Meaning and types of transport
objectives: By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to tell the meaning of transport.
By the end of the lesson, learners should be able to name road, water, air and railway transport.

sources.quote: Transport is the movement of people and goods
